name: kat-chat-flame
features: Connects to the chat backend and shows messages between members with names and colors.
Sends text and GIFs, and shows a reload banner when a new version is ready.
Appearance picks day, night, kat or orbit themes with a background picture and dimming.
Sound picks ding, meow or off, and notifications pick all, mentions or off, with ntfy connect.
Install app adds it to the home screen, and account status shows.
